title: Horseshoe Ridge RV Resort

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: 124 full-hookup resort sites with fiber Wi-Fi, hardwired ethernet at every pedestal, and 15-mile panoramic views - on 31 acres of live oaks in Wimberley, TX. Every site includes full hookups (water, sewer, 30/50A electric), fiber Wi-Fi, hardwired ethernet at the pedestal, valet trash, and a concrete pad. Horseshoe Ridge was built from the ground up as a luxury resort - not a campground that added amenities later. Every pedestal, every pad, and every detail was designed for the way you actually travel. Both delivered directly to your site - no driving to a fill station or hauling bags to a dumpster. Few Texas resorts offer both
